data.raw_provenance: Real *IDN? response captured on 2026-11-26 from AFG-2225 serial GEP902745, firmware V2.05, over USB CDC-ACM 2184:001c at /dev/ttyACM0. The raw bytes are indexed in assets/captures/captures.jsonl; the full exchange is in artifacts/hw-verify/afg2225-20261126/ (git-ignored, local reference only). This is read-back evidence, not a calibration certificate.

support.hardware_verified_scope: Restricted to the observations captured on 2026-11-26 from AFG-2225 serial GEP902745, firmware V2.05, USB CDC-ACM 2184:001c at /dev/ttyACM0: *IDN?; the two-line SYSTem:ERRor? format and its empty-queue form; read-only queries for function, frequency, amplitude (long form only), offset, output state, load, phase, duty cycle, counter state/value, and APPL?; single-parameter write/readback/restore of SOUR1:FREQ, SOUR1:AMPLITUDE, and SOUR1:DCO with the output OFF before and after; and one output-on loopback (SIN 1 kHz, 1 Vpp at 50 ohm reference, 0 V offset) into a GDS-2104A CH1 at 1 MOhm, measured 1.000E+03 Hz / 2.060E+00 Vpp / 7.27E-01 V RMS, then OUTP1 OFF and the original SIN 0.5 Hz / 3 Vpp setup restored. Every other command family remains documented.
known_limitations: Hardware evidence covers one unit, firmware, and interface; do not extend it to another AFG-2225 or firmware revision.

APPLy writes, ARB DATA:DAC uploads, modulation, sweep, burst, counter enable/measurement, phase/coupling writes, save/recall/delete, and calibration were not exercised. OUTPut ON/OFF was exercised once as an unloaded 1 kHz loopback, not across waveforms, levels, or loads.
Binary ARB byte order remains unverified; the ASCII decimal list is the default safe path.

The error queue is two lines on the wire: a CRLF-terminated code line and an unterminated message line, for example -102\r\nSyntax error.; the empty queue is \r\nNo error. The parser accepts this and the manual's single-line form.
SOUR<n>:APPL? returns a quoted composite string on the wire; the manual example omits the quotes.
SOUR<n>:AMPL? is rejected by V2.05 with no response and -113 Undefined header; use the long form SOUR<n>:AMPLITUDE?.
The manual and firmware provide no SCPI beeper command; the beeper is panel-only (UTIL -> F3 System -> F3 Beep -> F2 OFF).
The manual's DATA:DAC example claims 5 values / 16 bytes; actual byte count is 10 bytes. This is a documented manual defect.
115200 8N1 is the helper default, not a manual requirement; the verified link also answered at 9600 baud.
No LAN, GPIB, or RS-232 interface; USB device port only.
Voltage/amplitude accuracy, flatness, and calibration are not verified; one 1 kHz loopback point proves the command path and the 50 ohm-to-1 MOhm doubling, not a calibrated level.
Community observations (SOURCE1:OUTPUT ON versus OUTP1 ON, positive DC offset with ARB) remain unverified.

integrity.scope: hardware-verified subset only; unverified command families are listed as not_checked
